package domain_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func validLearningActionAssistance() domain.LearningActionAssistance {
	hintLevel := 3
	return domain.LearningActionAssistance{
		ID:                "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:         "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CorrelationID:     "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		CausationID:       "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID:  "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:         "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		SupportContext:    domain.TeacherSupportGuided,
		HintsUsed:         1,
		MaxHintLevel:      &hintLevel,
		Observations: []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{
				Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.error-wrapping", Version: "course-content-17"},
				Kind:   domain.TeacherObservationHintUsed,
			},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		CreatedAt:     time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestNewLearningActionAssistanceRejectsMasteryClaim(t *testing.T) {
	input := validLearningActionAssistance()
	input.Observations[0].Kind = "mastered"

	_, err := domain.NewLearningActionAssistance(input)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestNewLearningActionAssistanceRequiresConsistentHintAggregate(t *testing.T) {
	input := validLearningActionAssistance()
	input.MaxHintLevel = nil

	_, err := domain.NewLearningActionAssistance(input)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestLearningActionAssistanceEventDataOmitsTeacherStorageIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	assistance, err := domain.NewLearningActionAssistance(validLearningActionAssistance())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	payload, err := json.Marshal(assistance.EventData())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, string(payload), "personal_teacher_id")
	require.NotContains(t, string(payload), assistance.ID)
	require.Contains(t, string(payload), `"learning_action_id"`)
}
